files.title: Manual files
files.description: Upload the manual: one PDF, several PDFs, or photos of the pages (JPEG, PNG, WebP). Up to 15 pages or photos per run in total (PDF pages + extra photos). Over 15, the run stops with a message and nothing is charged.

fileUrls.title: Manual links
fileUrls.description: Or paste direct links to the PDF or photos. Google Drive and Dropbox share links are converted to direct downloads. Up to 50 MB per file.

includeImages.title: Reuse and clean pictures (Standard edition)
includeImages.description: On (default): pictures from your upload are straightened, cropped and cleaned, and get red numbered markers that match the rewritten steps (Standard edition). Off: text-only remake (Text-only edition). If no usable pictures are found, the run is automatically Text-only and priced as Text-only.

checklistMode.title: Add a checklist page
checklistMode.description: Adds tick boxes to every step and a one-page checklist at the end. Default: on.

title.title: Title override
title.description: Optional. Title for the remade manual. Leave empty to use the product name found in the source.

paperSize.title: Paper size
paperSize.description: Page size of the print PDF.

llmApiKey.title: LLM API key
llmApiKey.description: Required. Your own OpenAI API key (or a key for another OpenAI-compatible provider, with the base URL below). The rewrite runs on your key, so model usage is billed by your provider, not by this Actor. The key is stored encrypted by Apify and is never logged or saved in the output.

llmModel.title: LLM model
llmModel.description: Model name. Must accept pictures when you upload photos or scans (gpt-4o-mini and gpt-4o do). Default: gpt-4o-mini.

llmBaseUrl.title: LLM base URL
llmBaseUrl.description: Optional. Leave empty for OpenAI (https://api.openai.com/v1). For another OpenAI-compatible provider, paste its base URL ending in /v1.

pdfPassword.title: PDF password
pdfPassword.description: Optional. Only for password-protected PDFs you are allowed to open.
